findings.oracle: pyproject.toml [project].dependencies reduced from 113 packages to 15 genuine runtime imports (anthropic, capstone, cryptography, frida, google-genai, httpx, huggingface-hub, keyring, lief, openai, psutil, pyyaml, r2pipe, structlog, yara-python). The 22 dev-only packages (bandit, basedpyright, black, bumpversion, commitizen, flake8, isort, mkdocs-material, monkeytype, mypy, nox, pre-commit, pyannotate, pydoclint, pydocstyle, pylint, pytest, ruff, safety, sphinx, tox, twine) are absent from runtime deps and remain only in [project.optional-dependencies] extras. Both assertions pass: leaked & DEV_ONLY_PACKAGES == empty set, len(runtime) == 15 <= 25.

test_bridge_initial_state: real X64DbgBridge instance; after initial-state assertions, verifies that attached_pid, binary_path, and is_64bit accept mutations and the mutations persist — removing any setter or attribute would go red. test_bridge_has_capabilities: added assertions that supported_architectures is a non-empty list with at least 2 entries, supported_formats is a non-empty list, and supports_static_analysis is False; deleting any of those capability entries from the bridge definition goes red.

Real OAuthManager singleton via 32-thread ThreadPoolExecutor; after identity check adds generate_pkce_pair() invocation asserting code_verifier len > 40, code_challenge len > 30, verifier != challenge, verify_pkce_pair() returns True for fresh pair, returns False for mutated verifier. A singleton with corrupt internal PKCE state would fail the functional assertions even if identity is preserved.

Known input b'\xde\xad\xbe\xef' written to real temp file, opened in real HexEditorBridge, selected. c_array: parses comma-delimited hex tokens, decodes via int(t,16), asserts bytes == b'\xde\xad\xbe\xef'. rust_array: same decode. go_slice: same decode after stripping '[]byte{' prefix. python: asserts \xde/\xad/\xbe/\xef appear in inner escape sequence. markdown_table: asserts all four hex values DE/AD/BE/EF appear across data rows. Corrupting the encoding of any byte would go red.

Live Google API; after len > 0 check, filters for models with 'gemini' in id.lower(), asserts at least one Gemini model exists, then asserts first_gemini.id is non-empty str, first_gemini.provider == GOOGLE, first_gemini.context_window > 0. An API regression returning zero Gemini models or wrong provider would go red.

Real ProviderRegistry(credential_loader=None) + real Config(data_directory=tmp_path); asyncio.run() awaits init_model_discovery; asserts result is 2-tuple, result[0] is ModelDiscovery instance, result[1] is Path with parent==tmp_path and name=='model_discovery_cache.json'. A broken implementation raising on await, returning wrong types, or using wrong cache path would go red.
